structure_proposals.why: The hanging leg raise is the only thing left that makes Legs B different from Legs A, but it sits dead last on a twenty-two set night, and on 5 September both its sets were typed one second apart a day after the rest of the session — this runs it ahead of the cable crunch instead of at the tail.

Both push days now press dumbbells overhead at 8-10 reps, and PushB does it first and heaviest, so take the PushA sets up to 10-12 and let the two days stop being the same set — exactly how your chest press already splits 10-12 on PushA and 8-10 on PushB.
